blocks.html: Additional CORS configurations applied to the `/admin`, `/store`, and `/auth` API Routes.

types.name: maxAge
types.description: How long, in seconds, browsers can cache the response of a preflight request, set in the `Access-Control-Max-Age` header.

types.name: exposedHeaders
types.description: The response headers exposed to the browser, set in the `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` header.

types.name: allowedHeaders
types.description: The request headers allowed in cross-origin requests, set in the `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` header.

types.name: methods
types.description: The HTTP methods allowed in cross-origin requests, set in the `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` header.
